scope: Local NPC material and collision-aware work verification

checks: PASS A real camp and adult resident load for collision-aware local navigation
PASS The real capsule walks around a six-metre solid barrier instead of crossing it or spinning against it
PASS The collision-aware resident retains a valid persistent identity and position
PASS captured session validates with conversation memories
PASS The real camp and surrounding natural-resource tiles load
PASS The worker actually walks out, gathers a real resource, and returns a load to the household
PASS The delivered items really leave the hands/carrier and exist once on the ground
PASS The actual delivered load is on the household doorstep rather than left at its source
PASS The delivered load includes an actual shared-ledger natural branch
PASS A qualified worker completes a cold start through physical material retrieval, preparation and fire-drill work
PASS The fire-making kit is actually retrieved and carried, rather than assumed to exist
PASS The full movement/material/fire cycle validates for saving
PASS captured session validates with conversation memories
PASS The actual generated household camp is loaded
PASS The actual shelter contains recoverable portable contributions
PASS An itinerary progress change alone does not remove, create or swap any material
PASS A real adult claims a specific existing component
PASS The worker walks to the structure and spends work time before dismantling a component
PASS The removed component no longer owns its recovered goods
PASS The same recovered materials are carried or physically set down, rather than deleted
PASS Physical dismantling conserves all material identities and mass
PASS Recovered shelter cargo is really carried and excluded from automatic fire fuel
PASS A worker physically supplies and finishes the missing component using the recovered stock
PASS Reassembly conserves the same material identities and mass
PASS An observed arrival creates empty plans and hearths without manufacturing a second shelter or fire fuel
PASS The actual shelter has real lashing and poles for the bound-load check
PASS Actual recovered poles and lashing become one carried bound load with their exact contents preserved
PASS The bound load appears on the actual person using the existing material models
PASS An initial partially erected camp stages its complete finite stock once with exact original IDs and mass
PASS A second initial-stock request cannot manufacture another load
PASS Physical camp work and local itinerary state validate for saving
PASS captured session validates with conversation memories
PASS Two actual adult residents exist
PASS The physical actor uses its saved inventory rather than a prop-only loadout
PASS Repeated visual task changes create or delete no actual goods
PASS Every displayed NPC possession is a real carried item
PASS A healthy resident's complete belongings survive session copying
PASS Personal belongings remain marked as another person's property
PASS An owned real ground item can actually be stolen
PASS A seeing owner remembers who took the specific item
PASS A resident behind a real wall does not learn the theft magically
PASS Possession changes physically while the original ownership remains recorded
PASS Witnessed theft changes mood and the directed relationship
PASS The aimed owned item uses the actual red theft-prompt style
PASS No possession ID exists in both the world and an NPC inventory
PASS Owned goods and social consequences validate after the real transfer
PASS captured session validates with conversation memories
PASS An actual adult resident exists for material work
PASS A real uncollected fallen branch exists in loaded scatter
PASS Gathering the actual fallen branch uses the player's shared depletion ledger
PASS The gathered branch is a single real owned possession
PASS The same natural branch cannot be gathered twice
PASS A real harvested branch transfers its finite mass to the hearth
PASS The worker finds actual local tinder material
PASS Gathering fine material creates a real carried bundle
PASS Actually feeding the fine bundle relights live embers
PASS A real placed regional plant has a known edible above-ground product
PASS The worker harvests the actual regional plant in its controlled fruiting season
PASS Eating reduces the real harvested food quantity
PASS NPC knapping uses the same real stone recipe and removes mass from its core
PASS Harvested goods, natural ledgers, actual food consumption and crafting validate together
PASS captured session validates with conversation memories
